purpose: Teach: 慎太郎/康夫/優美/和也/正彦/すず/恭子/足下

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「石原慎太郎元都知事の本を読んでる」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was telling me about Ishihara Shintaro's book—he's been reading it.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact. Brief smile in the voice. Sharing something she thinks will interest him. Natural conversational cadence, no performance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんのお友達の康夫おじさんに会ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I met Dad's friend Uncle Yasuo today.
lines.style: Bright, eager to report. Slight lift at the end—checking to see if this news lands. Natural childhood enthusiasm without exaggeration.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ご親戚の優美さんが結婚されたわ」って語って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father mentioned that our relative Yumi got married.
lines.style: Gentle, thoughtful delivery. Slight pause before 'got married'—acknowledging the significance. Warm undercurrent. Almost sharing a quiet reflection with him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが「和也くんは将来有望」って褒めてらしたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad said that Kazuya has a bright future ahead of him.
lines.style: Earnest and clear. Pride in his voice at repeating the compliment. Slight emphasis on the phrase—he wants to get it right, to deliver what Dad said.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「正彦伯父様にもお元気でいらしてほしい」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was saying he hopes Uncle Masahiko stays healthy.
lines.style: Quiet, genuine warmth. Paced gently. A moment of care in the voice—she's sharing something sincere that Dad said. Almost tender.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとペットのすずちゃんを撫でたよ
lines.en: Mom, I petted Suzu with Dad today.
lines.style: Bright, simple joy. Small smile on 'Suzu.' Natural child's voice—reporting a small happiness without embellishment. Warm and uncomplicated.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんとお友達の恭子さんとお茶会されてたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was having tea with his friend Kyoko.
lines.style: Observant, gentle. Matter-of-fact warmth. She's noticing and sharing what she saw—no judgment, just the simple fact of it. Calm, present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「足下に注意して歩け」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad taught me to watch my step when I walk.
lines.style: Clear, attentive. Pride in following the lesson. Earnest in the delivery—he's taking it seriously, wants her to know he listened. Quiet conviction.
